csv_project_name: Project Development For I 70 Access Control
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_location: Marion (IN), Jasper (IN), Lake (IN), Morgan (IN), Putnam (IN), Tippecanoe (IN)
csv_scope_of_work: Project Development Services - Access Control Project (Right-of-Way), Access Control Project at various locations within the Crawfordsville District (4) and Laporte District (2). The selected firm shall perform preliminary engineering and plan development services necessary to produce construction contract documents for the listed project(s) in accordance with INDOTs designated letting schedule. The selected firm will also be responsible for: Environmental Document, Permit Applications, Topographic Survey, Design and Plan Development, Right-of-Way Plan Development (including Right-of-Way Engineering, Title Research, and Staking), Real Estate Acquisition Services (including Right-of-Way Management, Appraising, Review Appraising, Buying, Closing, and Relocations, as needed),
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Archaeology, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Project Development for I-70 Access Control
short_description: Project development services for I-70 access control improvements at multiple Indiana locations.
project_location: Marion, Jasper, Lake, Morgan, Putnam, and Tippecanoe counties, Indiana, USA; various locations within the Crawfordsville District and LaPorte District.
project_scope: Access control project development for I-70 and related locations, including preliminary engineering and plan development to produce construction contract documents. Scope includes engineering assessment/alternative analysis where missing, environmental documentation, permit applications, topographic survey, design and plan development, right-of-way plan development, title research, staking, and real estate acquisition services. services: Project development services; preliminary engineering; plan development; engineering assessment/alternative analysis; environmental documentation; permit applications; topographic survey; design; right-of-way engineering and plan development; title research; staking; real estate acquisition services; utility engineering; traffic design engineering; surveying/GIS/mapping; archaeology.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a highway access control and right-of-way project, not a bridge or special structure.
- Focus is on project development, environmental, survey, and real estate acquisition services rather than structural engineering.
- No indication of bridge design, long-span structures, or architecturally demanding components.
- Low fit with sbp's core strengths in bridges, lightweight structures, roofs, and special structures.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided in the notice.
references_qualifications: No specific bidder reference or qualification requirements are stated in the notice. Requested disciplines include architecture services, surveying/GIS/mapping, environmental engineering/planning/design, archaeology, utility engineering, and traffic design engineering.
contracting_authority: State of Indiana Department of Transportation (INDOT), Agency ID 20750. Contact: Jessica Miller. Phone: 855-463-6848. Website: https://pscsrfp.indot.in.gov/Rfp/TwelveMonthRfp#
